title: Nuluno Engine Community 0.13.0a2 preview
notes:
Apache-2.0 Nuluno Engine Community 0.13.0a2 prerelease.

Exact source: 60dd4cbf521a43e54e7a4382945da58e872ac950. Reviewed readiness run 43668195543 and immutable artifact 14143008028. Four exact assets only: wheel, source ZIP, release manifest and SHA256SUMS.

New source-brief example produces a real bounded public-source artifact, reuses the original receipt in a new process with one reserved provider read, revokes its original key, and returns exit 3 on a later fresh-process denial. The actual Linux public-source run is https://github.com/wangthewhale/nuluno-engine-community/actions/runs/43668286657 . Core CI also booted and replaced the real Linux container while preserving state and revocation.

The Python RPC SDK identifies this Community version. Confirmed Cloudflare 1010 and recognized no-auth-challenge edge block pages are safe transport classifications; invalid credentials remain denied, with no key renewal or automatic POST retry.

The complete S01 starter and executable core are included; the commercial 99-goal sales-method library is not. Earlier held-out method candidates remain rejected. Successful self-evolution, sales lift, external human adoption, lower complete costs and private Gmail-to-publication acceptance are not established. Costs without sources remain unknown. No PyPI/npm publication, permanent hosted service, CAPTCHA bypass or signed-attestation claim.
